01 — About

A bit
about me.

I'm from Pokhara, and I learn by actually building things — a store, an app, and this website.

Student by day, store owner the rest of the time.

I'm studying Bachelor of Computer System and Information Technology at Pokhara College of Management (since 2023). In May–June 2024 I completed digital marketing training at Pokhara Metropolitan City's Business Promotion Center, where I learned e-commerce, social media handling and online promotion properly.

After that training I started Digi Nepal. Selling subscriptions sounds simple until you have to remember which account expires when and which customer is on which profile — so I built Digi Manager to manage exactly that. Both are live, and I use them every day.
